renderer-benchmark.title: Renderer Benchmark
renderer-benchmark.screen.intro: Finds out whether Vulkan or OpenGL runs Minecraft better on your PC. The camera flies the same route over a fresh world on each, with the same settings, while every frame is timed. The game has to restart once in between, and your settings are put back afterwards.
renderer-benchmark.screen.noVulkan: Vulkan can't run on this PC, so there is nothing to compare: %s
renderer-benchmark.screen.pending: %s is selected for the second half. Restart the game to finish the comparison.
renderer-benchmark.screen.confirm.title: Compare Vulkan and OpenGL?
renderer-benchmark.screen.confirm.messag: First the camera flies over a temporary world on %s. Then the game asks you to restart on %s and flies again. It takes about %s minutes; keep the window open and don't touch anything while it flies. If you are in a world, you will leave it.
renderer-benchmark.restart.title: Restart on %s
renderer-benchmark.restart.message: %s is done. The Graphics API is now set to %s, which only takes effect after a restart. Start the game again and the comparison continues by itself.
renderer-benchmark.continue.title: Continue on %s?
renderer-benchmark.continue.message: The game now runs on %s. The camera flies the same route again, then you get the results.
renderer-benchmark.unavailable.title: %s didn't start
renderer-benchmark.unavailable.message: The game was supposed to start on %s but started on %s. Either it fell back because it failed, or a launcher option forces the graphics API. The comparison was cancelled and your setting put back.
renderer-benchmark.stopped.title: Comparison stopped
renderer-benchmark.stopped.loadFailed: The temporary world didn't load. Your settings were put back.
renderer-benchmark.stopped.cancelled: You left the world, so the comparison stopped. Your settings were put back.
renderer-benchmark.stopped.interrupted: The game closed while the camera was flying, so the comparison stopped. Your settings were put back.
renderer-benchmark.nextStart.title: Takes effect after a restart
renderer-benchmark.nextStart.message: The game starts on %s next time.
renderer-benchmark.verdict.tie: Both APIs run about the same on your PC
renderer-benchmark.verdict.faster.same: %s is %s%% faster, with about the same stutter
renderer-benchmark.results.title: Renderer Benchmark Results
renderer-benchmark.results.windowChanged: The window size changed (%s, then %s), so the numbers may not be comparable.
